# Three.js

`three.module.js` and `three.core.js` are unmodified browser modules from
Three.js **0.180.0**, distributed under the accompanying MIT license.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.180.0.tgz

These files are served by the Lean server. Playing a saved or built-in adventure
does not contact a CDN and requires no JavaScript build or package installation.
